383:t_1:86.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I... have to get dinner ready... So, bye.」

383:t_1:90.en:
$$シン$$
「Just so you know, we weren't listening to you and $$ティティ$$ talk.」

383:t_1:93.en:
$n
「...Little by little, I feel like I'm starting to see a way to make the $$ジェニオン$$ and myself one.」

383:t_1:94.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you can spread your consciousness outward through the machine.」

383:t_1:95.en:
$n
「Is that what it feels like when you're riding the $$Ｚガンダム$$...?」

383:t_1:96.en:
$$シン$$
「I kind of get it, too. My head clears, and the $$デスティニーガンダム$$ feels like a part of my own body.」

383:t_1:97.en:
$n
「So I've gotten a little closer to where you two are.」

383:t_1:98.en:
$$シン$$
「In simulator matches, I've got no intention of letting you catch up for a good while yet.」

383:t_1:99.en:
$n
「Don't think I'll settle for that forever.」

383:t_1:100.en:
$$シン$$
「Then later I'll show you my real skill until you're sick of it.」

383:t_1:101.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Sounds like your spirits are up.」

383:t_1:102.en:
$n
「I can't afford to keep my head down.」

383:t_1:103.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Then let me have my say. It's about Miss $$スズネ$$.」

383:t_1:105.en:
$$シン$$
「We want to hear how ready you are. If Miss $$スズネ$$ were mind-controlled by $$バルビエル$$ and came at you as an enemy, what would you do?」

383:t_1:107.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バルビエル$$ is a Reactor, so I don't think his mind control will break that easily.」

383:t_1:108.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What will you do then? Shoot Miss $$スズネ$$, or get shot by her?」

383:t_1:110.en:
$$シン$$
「You don't have to answer right now... But the time will surely come when you're forced to choose.」

383:t_1:111.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Make up your mind before then.」

383:t_1:115.en:
$$シン$$
「The answer beyond that is yours to find, $n.」

383:t_2:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「This empty space...! Is this what $n's mind is like right now...!」

383:t_2:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「A hell where you can't cling to hope, and aren't even allowed to fall into despair...」

383:t_2:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「This is bad...! My senses are being stolen, too!」

383:t_2:11.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That's right, $$マーズ$$. I came to help you.」

383:t_2:13.en:
$$マーグ$$
「A world beyond both hope and despair... The infinity within him... his potential.」

383:t_2:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「How did you get here, Big Bro?」

383:t_2:16.en:
$$マーグ$$
「The dark elder brother and the light younger brother... We are one soul that was meant to be whole, split in two...」

383:t_2:17.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That's exactly why we have a darkness and a light stronger than anyone else's.」

383:t_2:19.en:
$$マーグ$$
「Though I lost my body, my soul lives on inside you...」

383:t_2:20.en:
$$マーグ$$
「And the darkness that grew within me and the light within you will fuse into one.」

383:t_2:21.en:
$$タケル$$
「Doesn't that mean we'd wipe each other out...?」

383:t_2:22.en:
$$マーグ$$
「No. When two opposites collide, something beyond both is bound to be born.」

383:t_2:23.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That's why we were able to come here.」

383:t_2:25.en:
$$マーグ$$
「As you are now, you probably can't accept it.」

383:t_2:26.en:
$$マーグ$$
「But show him. A glimpse of the new power that is born there.」

383:t_2:28.en:
$$マーグ$$
「$$マーズ$$! Use my power!」

383:t_2:29.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wake up, $n! Overcome both hope and despair!!」

383:t_3:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「To think you'd overcome the $$スフィアの反作用$$ in such a short time.」

383:t_3:6.en:
$n
「I only recovered thanks to $$タケル$$. It wasn't my own strength.」

383:t_3:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「But you should have gotten the hang of it. You can do the rest on your own.」

383:t_3:8.en:
$n
「Thanks, $$タケル$$... And I'll thank your brother, too.」

383:t_3:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「I see... So you felt him, too.」

383:t_3:10.en:
$$シン$$
「The new $$ジェニオン$$ motion you were practicing is finished, too.」

383:t_3:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「You should thank us, too, for putting up with your special training.」

383:t_3:13.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Knock it off. Just because you're starting to stop being the quiet type doesn't mean anyone wants your smile.」

383:t_3:14.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, now you've got a prospect of fighting on your own. Shouldn't you be happier about it?」

383:t_3:15.en:
$n
「No... not yet. I can't let my guard down until we get Miss $$スズネ$$ back... and until we take back the Earth.」

383:t_3:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「But, hey, once we get Miss $$スズネ$$ back, there'll be a whole new problem.」

383:t_3:20.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That's it, I've decided! I'm going to challenge Miss $$スズネ$$!」

383:t_3:22.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So make sure you rescue Miss $$スズネ$$, no matter what. I don't want to lose by forfeit.」

383:t_3:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「But judging by $$ギルター$$ today, $$バルビエル$$ will come at us with moves we can't even imagine.」

383:t_3:26.en:
$n
「It's all right, $$カレン$$. $$宗介$$ is reining in my elation.」

383:t_3:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「What do you intend to do, $n?」
